items.title: High-Performance Data Analysis with Exasol - Full Course (1 Hour)
items.author: Andreas Kretz
items.summary:
Dive into a new way of running machine learning and AI directly inside your database with Exasol!

Instead of exporting data to external services, you run Python UDFs (user defined functions), scikit-learn models, and Hugging Face language models straight from SQL, on your own infrastructure, without moving a single row out of the database.

In this full course, you'll learn how to set up a high-performance MPP database on AWS, design tables for maximum query performance, and turn Exasol into a full in-database AI and ML platform.

👉 Here's what you'll build:

✅ A fully functional Exasol MPP cluster on your own AWS account
✅ Python UDFs that call live APIs from inside a SQL query
✅ A scikit-learn classifier trained and deployed inside the database
✅ A Hugging Face zero-shot classification model running from SQL
✅ A conversational BI setup with MCP and a local LLM on your own infrastructure

And on top of that:

✅ Understand distribution keys and partition keys with real benchmark numbers
✅ See what cluster scaling actually does to query and import performance
✅ Run the TPC-H benchmark on one node vs four nodes and compare the results

⏱️ Timestamps

00:00 – Course Introduction and Overview
02:30 – What Is MPP and How Does It Work?
08:07 – Setting Up Exasol Personal on AWS
13:10 – Connecting to Exasol and Loading Your First Dataset
18:07 – Distribution Keys, Partition Keys, and Why Exasol Is Fast
24:10 – Cluster Scaling, Distribution Key Performance, and Query Best Practices
34:22 – Running Python Inside the Database with User-Defined Functions
41:23 – Setting Up the Exasol AI Lab
47:55– Training a scikit-learn Model and Running Predictions from SQL
55:04 – Text Classification with a Hugging Face Model Inside Exasol
01:01:24 – Natural Language Queries with MCP and a Local LLM
01:05:35 – Course Recap and Next Steps

Resources:

► GitHub Repo for this course: https://github.com/andkret/exasol-personal/tree/main
► Exasol Personal (free): https://www.exasol.com/personal/
► All free labs & resources: https://learndataengineering.com/p/free-labs
